texts.zh: 我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]已经在大量收集来自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的信号取得了稳步的进展。然而，随着我们对他们语言的知识储备越来越丰富，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]却越来越感到迷惑。很明显他们不得不对先前工作的翻译进行数次重新评估，因为他们发现先前认定文字的含义事实上极度不准确。似乎[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的整体面貌和我们极度相异——比我们能够想象的差的更多！
texts.en: Our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] have been making steady progress gathering together a large collection of signals from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. However, as our knowledge of their language has grown, our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have become ever more confused. Apparently, they have had to reassess their previous working translations several times after finding out that the meanings they had ascribed to words were, in fact, extremely inaccurate. It seems that the whole outlook of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] is very different to ours - far more than we could possibly have imagined!

texts.zh: 尽管我们在大量收集来自[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的信号方面取得了稳步的进展，而我们在真正理解这些信号的方面的进展……被彻底压倒了。我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]已经被迫对他们先前的翻译工作进行了数次的重新评估，因为发现他们之前认定文字的含义事实上非常不准确。似乎[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的思维模式和我们相异甚远——比我们之前认为的差的更多，即使是对于外星人而言！
texts.en: While we have made steady progress on gathering together a large collection of signals from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], our progress on coming to actually understand these signals has been... underwhelming. Already, our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have been forced to reassess their previous working translations several times after finding out that the meanings they had ascribed to words were, in fact, extremely inaccurate. It seems that the thought patterns of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] are very different to our own - far more than we had considered possible, even among aliens!

Already, our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have been forced to reassess their previous working translations several times after finding out that the meanings they had ascribed to words were, in fact, extremely inaccurate. It seems that the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] does not base its execution logic on any sort of rationality known to us. This will make understanding them a severe challenge!

summary.text:
# 迷惑的信号 / Confusing Signals
- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 首次接触随机插曲 first-contact random interlude
- 来源 Sources：`events/first_contact_random_events.txt:481-512` · `common/scripted_effects/first_contact_effects.txt:1257-1795`
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（c7b-society）

## 如何开始 How it starts

首次接触阶段进度检定失败时（on_roll_failed → standard_first_contact_on_roll_failed）：先给线索，再有 1/20 概率从阶段指定的事件池里按权重抽一个，同一站点 125 天内最多触发一次（flag first_contact_event_fired）（`first_contact_effects.txt:1257–1294`）。本事件在以下池中：晚期事件池 late_fc_random_events（默认第二阶段及各收尾阶段） 权重1。/ When a stage progress roll fails (on_roll_failed → standard_first_contact_on_roll_failed): clues are added, then a 1-in-20 chance draws one event from the stage’s pool by weight, at most once per 125 days per site. This event sits in: late pool (default stage 2 and the end stages) weight 1。

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

**信号令人困惑（5040）**：伦理差异太大，译码困难，−2 阶段线索。 / Confusing signals: deep ethical differences; −2 stage clues.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

单选项。 / Single option.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

仅当双方对立伦理差异超过2步，或一方是格式塔而另一方不是（`first_contact_effects.txt:1543–1570`）。 / Only when the two sides’ opposing-ethics divergence exceeds 2 steps, or exactly one of them is gestalt. 每个站点每个事件最多一次（flag fc_event_5040 或同类标记）。/ Once per site.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：脚本、scripted effect 中各池的权重与零权重条件、standard_first_contact_on_roll_failed。/ Script, per-pool weights and exclusions, and the roll-failure wrapper.
- 审阅改动 Changes：无结构改动（独立插曲页）；补充了触发池与条件。/ No structural change; trigger pools and conditions added.
